page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is configured with 124 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, particularly in stress-ng, Geekbench, and single-threaded compression tasks like gzip and bzip3. Multi-core performance is also strong, ranking in the top tier for Geekbench multi-core tests and the top 25% for PassMark CPU and software compilation workloads. Memory bandwidth and database operations, such as Redis SET, perform in the average tier. The CPU supports advanced vector extensions, including AVX-512 and AVX_VNNI, which assist in cryptographic and integer operations.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring high single-threaded performance without the overhead of specialized GPU or local storage hardware. It is well-suited for software compilation, text and image processing, static web serving, and small-scale language model inference.
